build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search parameters
build_task_gap_scenario: build a gap scenario task where a ball must roll into a container by preventing a support from falling
add_convex_polygon_slope: add a convex polygon to the PHYRE scene using C.add_convex_polygon with converted vertices
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene using C.add with radius and center coordinates
update_task_relationship: update the task goal by setting body1 and body2 with a TOUCHING spatial relationship
